task_title: AI runner equips Floor 1 boss chest weapon upgrades

plan_review.notes: 3 rounds with gpt-5.6-sol. Round 1 forked the design (rejected planner-side DPS pre-pass) in favor of a canonical static weapon baseline inside the evaluator. Round 2 was the adversarial pass (3 alternatives argued: planner pre-pass, synthetic generated instance, evaluator static baseline) and raised the weapon-class-switch policy, structural WeaponDef input, and static affinity weights. Round 3 pushed back on the same-weaponTypeSkillId restriction with data (it rejects ~80% of Wave-A drops and 100% for baseball-bat/punch starters, and does not preserve personas because WEAPON_PERSONAS keys on WeaponDef id); reviewer accepted the counter-remedy (deterministic weaponTypeSkillId persona fallback + 25-seed gate as arbiter) and signed off with no remaining blockers.
